title: Marii: Offline-First AI Quotation & Invoice Engine
short_description: Instant AI quote generator with voice-to-RFQ parsing, ZAR currency formatting, business catalogue matching, PDF export, and direct Evolution WhatsApp dispatch.
why_built: Small service businesses across Southern Africa waste hours creating manual quotes and invoices. Marii automates quoting via voice and text over WhatsApp with instant PDF delivery and ZAR formatting.
development_approach: Built an offline-first catalog matching engine for local price lists and service items.
Implemented voice-to-RFQ speech parsing using Whisper models to extract requested line items.
Integrated WhatsApp Cloud API and Evolution API for automated client dispatch.
Designed automated PDF invoice generation with bitemporal audit trails for tax compliance.

challenges.challenge: Handling colloquial voice notes and non-standard product descriptions from field workers.
challenges.solution: Used structured LLM extraction with fallback fuzzy catalog matching against local business inventories.

outcomes: Cut quote generation time from 45 minutes to under 30 seconds for field teams.
Enabled instant WhatsApp dispatch with ZAR currency formatting.

title: AcademiaTrack: AI Student Performance Portal & Report Analytics

development_approach: Integrated AI vision models for OCR document extraction from paper report card images and PDFs.
Architected normalized subject performance models tracking term-over-term percentile changes.
Built a parent-facing portal with trajectory visualizer and milestone time-capsules.

challenges.challenge: Parsing varied report card layouts from different South African public and private schools.
challenges.solution: Developed a multi-stage layout parser with schema validation to extract subject names, marks, and teacher comments accurately.

outcomes: Automated extraction of historical school report cards with zero manual data entry.
Provided visual growth metrics for parents and academic advisors.
metrics: 98% OCR accuracy across South African school report formats

title: SchoolShop: WhatsApp Uniform Store & Lost Property Marketplace

Increased tenant maintenance satisfaction through transparent status tracking.

why_built: Traditional visitor access apps require mandatory app downloads and breach resident privacy. Muyeni delivers instant visitor PIN passes directly through WhatsApp with POPIA-compliant data protection.

Designed a lightweight security guard tablet web app for scanning and validating codes at the gate.
Implemented POPIA auto-expiring visitor log storage for privacy compliance.

challenges.challenge: Ensuring gate verification works smoothly under unstable mobile network coverage.
challenges.solution: Implemented offline pass caching on the guard terminal with background cloud sync.

outcomes: Zero app downloads needed for residents or visitors.
Cut gate entrance verification time to under 5 seconds per vehicle.
metrics: 100% POPIA compliance with automated log purge

title: Practice Assistant: Medical WhatsApp AI & Practice Management
short_description: Automates patient WhatsApp booking, Google Reviews collection, Medical Aid tariff validation, and POPIA Section 18 digital consent tracking for South African medical practices.
why_built: Medical receptionist staff spend hours answering repetitive booking queries and collecting paper consent forms. Practice Assistant handles patient communication over WhatsApp.
development_approach: Built a WhatsApp AI booking assistant integrated with practice management calendars.

Dramatically improved practice online ratings and patient intake speed.

title: Leriso: Speed-Optimized POS & Kitchen Management System
short_description: A speed-optimized, multi-currency Point of Sale (POS) system for fast-paced dining in Southern Africa, bridging cashier registers, live kitchen displays, and back-office analytics.
why_built: Busy restaurants in Southern Africa face frequent load shedding and connectivity drops that paralyze online POS systems. Leriso provides uninterrupted offline-first ordering.
development_approach: Architected a local SQLite offline register engine with auto-reconnecting PostgreSQL cloud sync.
Built real-time websocket Kitchen Display System (KDS) for order routing across prep stations.
Integrated ZAR currency formatting and split-bill calculation capabilities.

challenges.challenge: Preventing duplicate transaction logs when internet reconnects during peak dinner rushes.
challenges.solution: Used idempotent transaction UUIDs and multi-master conflict resolution logic.

outcomes: Guaranteed zero restaurant downtime during internet or power outages.
Accelerated kitchen order turnaround times.

title: EduGateKeeper: School Entrance Security & Attendance Kiosk
short_description: Replaces manual paper rosters at school entrances with an offline-resilient tablet kiosk for drop-offs/pickups and staff logins, paired with a central Web Admin Dashboard for real-time security tracking.
why_built: School entrance security relies on messy paper visitor books that fail in emergencies. EduGateKeeper provides digital tablet check-in with live headcount dashboards.

Built a cloud Web Admin Dashboard for emergency evacuation roll calls and real-time security alerts.
Integrated SMS/WhatsApp notifications for parent pickup confirmations.

challenges.challenge: Ensuring high-speed check-in during morning drop-off rushes with hundreds of students.
challenges.solution: Optimized barcode and QR code scanner intake to achieve sub-second check-in times.

outcomes: Eliminated entrance paper logs across participating schools.
Provided instant emergency roll calls for school security heads.

short_description: Streamlines and automates the multi-step checkout & exit verification process for customers leaving hardware stores after purchase, preventing bottlenecking and reducing theft risk.
why_built: Hardware stores suffer long exit queues due to double-checking paper receipts and physical items to prevent inventory shrink.
development_approach: Designed a digital receipt verification workflow matching POS purchases to exit gate scans.
Built security guard verification screens highlighting high-value items requiring physical check.
Integrated real-time discrepancy alerts for store management.

challenges.challenge: Preventing checkout bottlenecking while maintaining strict loss prevention controls.

short_description: Enables cross-border logistics operators and truckers to process border customs and clearance documents remotely prior to arrival, drastically cutting transit wait times and administrative delays.

development_approach: Engineered a digital document portal for pre-uploading manifest, customs, and vehicle papers.
Built automated document validation and QR code border pass generation.
Integrated real-time border post queue monitoring for fleet dispatchers.

challenges.challenge: Cross-verifying multi-national customs documentation formats between SADC countries.
challenges.solution: Standardized document ingestion rules with automated field mapping and validation.

outcomes: Streamlined regional freight movement between South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Zambia.
Reduced border waiting times from days to hours.
metrics: Planned platform for SADC freight corridors
Targeted 75% reduction in border processing time

title: Project Kganya: Enterprise AI Knowledge & Student Support Engine
short_description: Enterprise RAG knowledge engine and support platform deployed at University of Pretoria, featuring pgvector hybrid search, Chatwoot account boundaries, source-record auditability, and multi-channel student support.
why_built: University student support at the University of Pretoria was high-volume and repetitive. Project Kganya was architected to deflect support loads, enforce strict org-level tenant isolation, and ensure AI answers are derived from auditable, staff-editable source records.
development_approach: Architected a pgvector retrieval layer with organization_id metadata to enforce server-side tenant isolation.
Implemented a source-record architecture where staff edit canonical documents and vector embeddings remain derived indexes.
Designed classifier-first routing with single retrieval agents to preserve determinism and cut response latencies.
Integrated Chatwoot account boundaries and WhatsApp Cloud API channels to support high-volume student inquiries.

challenges.challenge: Ensuring AI responses never hallucinate policy details during high-volume exam and admissions periods.
challenges.solution: Constrained vector search to org-scoped source records with strict refusal guardrails when grounding evidence is absent.

outcomes: Deployed at University of Pretoria as a primary pilot for high-volume automated student support.
Reduced staff turnaround time for repetitive academic policy inquiries to sub-second responses.

title: Project Lumen: Multi-Tenant AI Knowledge Ingestion & Governance Gateway
short_description: Multi-tenant AI knowledge ingestion and routing gateway connecting organizational documents to any LLM provider via pgvector, Celery async workers, and Row-Level Security.
why_built: Organisational knowledge is frequently locked in messy, siloed documents. Project Lumen acts as a vendor-neutral AI Gateway that ingests, governs, and routes enterprise knowledge to any AI model without lock-in.
development_approach: Built a Modular Monolith architecture combining Next.js dashboard UI, FastAPI backend, and Celery + Redis async worker queues.
Enforced Row-Level Security (RLS) and Clerk organization UUID mapping for multi-tenant data boundaries.
Implemented an AI Gateway adapter layer allowing seamless switching between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
Designed the 'Ledger Quiet' visual design system for an enterprise-grade UI experience.

challenges.challenge: Preventing Celery background workers from exhausting database connection pools during long LLM I/O cycles.
challenges.solution: Decoupled database session lifetimes from LLM network calls, using short-lived transactions and inline fallback processing.

outcomes: Established a vendor-neutral AI Gateway supporting rapid knowledge retrieval across enterprise documents.
Implemented strict POPIA and RLS multi-tenancy safeguards across all vector operations.
metrics: Zero vendor lock-in across AI model providers

title: SchoolFoundry: Offline-First School OS & B2B Lead CRM
short_description: Offline-resilient school management system and lead intelligence CRM operating across South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe with local SQLite storage and WhatsApp parent communication.

challenges.challenge: Maintaining data consistency across offline desktop bundles and cloud sync servers.

Provided 100% operational uptime during connectivity outages and load shedding.
metrics: Integrated regional coverage across South Africa, Zambia & Zimbabwe

development_approach: Engineered a shared Next.js and Electron desktop shell to deliver uniform user experiences on web and desktop.
Designed an Analytics Engine core where the 'analytics-to-work loop' acts as the primary user navigation spine.
Implemented a normalized PostgreSQL DDL schema with Clerk authentication and Vercel Blob file storage.

challenges.challenge: Preventing offline client mutations from conflicting during cloud synchronization.
challenges.solution: Applied append-only transaction logs and deterministic state reconciliation in the local engine.

outcomes: Delivered a desktop-native real estate OS optimized for African real estate operators.
Streamlined property listing, lead tracking, and deal pipeline management.
metrics: Single codebase serving Web & Electron Desktop

title: Autonomous Inventory System - ETL Pipeline
short_description: Production-ready Python ETL pipeline using DLT, DuckDB, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and pandas to solve the mining industry's shadow stock problem with auditable, AI-ready inventory data.
why_built: Designed to address the mining industry's shadow stock problem by creating a reliable, auditable inventory data foundation that reduces operational leakage and supports downstream decision-making.
development_approach: Implemented a Medallion Architecture (Bronze â†’ Silver â†’ Gold) to transform raw daily transactions into high-integrity, analytics-ready assets.
Developed bitemporal data models to handle late-arriving events and enable accurate point-in-time financial reconstruction and auditability.
Utilized DLT (Data Load Tool) for idempotent ingestion, eliminating duplication and tracking schema evolution automatically.
Exposed a FastAPI layer backed by SQLAlchemy, DuckDB, and pandas to deliver reliable, queryable inventory views.
Designed an AI-ready interface with agent-safe guardrails and reliability scoring to feed validated data into AI decision engines.

challenges.challenge: Maintaining a fully auditable view of inventory while ingesting late-arriving and corrected transactions.
challenges.solution: Adopted bitemporal modeling and idempotent DLT-based ingestion to ensure consistent, reconstructable inventory states over time.

challenges.challenge: Serving AI-ready inventory data without exposing downstream agents to noisy or partially validated records.
challenges.solution: Introduced an AI-facing FastAPI layer with guardrails and reliability scoring, ensuring only validated views are surfaced to decision engines.

outcomes: Created a production-grade ETL pipeline tailored to mining inventory and shadow stock use cases.
Improved traceability and auditability of inventory data through bitemporal modeling and Medallion layering.
Established a clean, reliable surface for AI-driven analytics and decision support.

title: Elite Defense Academy DBMS + ETL Pipeline

Authored representative SQL queries and views to answer operational and reporting questions for the academy.

challenges.challenge: Designing a flexible schema that supports evolving course structures and enrollment rules.
challenges.solution: Applied normalization and clear relationship modeling to separate concerns and keep the schema extensible.

outcomes: Produced a reusable database design blueprint for academic or training-focused organizations.
Enabled consistent querying of students, courses, instructors, and performance across the academy.

title: MFZ AI Chatbot: Automated Lead Routing & Support System
short_description: 24/7 intelligent WhatsApp & webchat assistant built on Botpress that automates lead qualification, geographic branch routing, and fair loan officer assignment while answering customer queries from a verified RAG knowledge base.
why_built: Replaced MFZ Zambia's manual head-office WhatsApp operator with an automated, always-on system that can qualify leads, provide accurate answers from verified MFZ policies, and route customers to the right branch or loan officer without human bottlenecks.
development_approach: Designed the conversation and decision flows in Botpress to capture user intent, collect key lead information, and guide customers through province and branch selection.
Implemented a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) layer using a curated MFZ knowledge base so the bot only answers from verified internal policies and documentation.
Modeled provinces, branches, loan officers, and assignment counters in Botpress Tables to support geographic routing and stateful distribution.
Built a fair load-balancing algorithm that assigns new loan leads to the officer at the selected branch with the lowest current assignment count (round-robin style).
Configured WhatsApp Cloud API and webchat channels so the bot can operate seamlessly on both mobile and web entry points.

challenges.challenge: Ensuring the bot stayed compliant and did not share sensitive financial terms like interest rates or repayment amounts.
challenges.solution: Constrained the bot's responses to a verified MFZ knowledge base and explicitly restricted it from answering detailed pricing questions, instead handing off those topics to the assigned human loan officer.

challenges.challenge: Distributing leads fairly across many loan officers while respecting geography and avoiding overload.
challenges.solution: Implemented a stateful assignment counter per officer in Botpress Tables and built logic to always route new leads to the officer with the lowest current assignment at the selected branch.

outcomes: Eliminated the single-operator bottleneck at MFZ head office by automating lead capture, qualification, and routing.
Captured every after-hours lead via 24/7 availability, reducing the risk of losing customers to competitors due to delayed responses.
Provided standardized, accurate responses for all customers based on MFZ's verified policies and service descriptions.
Gave management better visibility into traffic, product interest, and branch/loan officer load patterns via chatbot interaction data.

title: TenantShield: Unified Access Control & POPIA Audit Logger

challenges.challenge: Auditing thousands of database queries without creating API performance latency.
challenges.solution: Implemented asynchronous batch logging with sub-millisecond query interceptors.

outcomes: Zero cross-tenant data leaks across portfolio applications.

title: SyncHub: Asynchronous Event Bus & Background Worker Queue
short_description: Centralized asynchronous message bus and Redis worker queue handling cross-product event distribution and third-party webhook retry logic.

development_approach: Built an event dispatcher using Redis and BullMQ to decouple API requests from execution.

Exposed real-time queue health metrics and log telemetry.

challenges.challenge: Handling transient network outages during third-party API webhooks.
challenges.solution: Implemented idempotent job receipts and automated retry state machines.

outcomes: Guaranteed background task execution with zero user-facing response delays.
High reliability for messaging and sync workflows.

challenges.solution: Designed an integrated suite of 8 tools (Working Paper Generator, Email Tracker, etc.) that work together for complete workflow coverage.

challenges.solution: Built tools to process workflows 10x faster and reduce audit cycle times by using efficient, automated methods.

Improved report quality and ensured 100% compliance with built-in checks and audit trails.

title: UniExplorer: University Program Aggregator & Eligibility Calculator
